title: PCFL-Compose v2 exact staged behavior-first self-revision DEV
summary: Proposal-only replacement for PCFL-Compose v1 and a single inference-only text DEV kill-switch. It preserves the factorized public-prefix h fork, matched independent q negative, OPAQUE_NOTE_SELF primary, and separately generated non-rescuing OPERATOR_AST diagnostic. Stage 0 has a 1,540 CPU-minute mandatory ledger under an exact 1,560-minute (26 CPU-hour) cap. The all-pass scientific ceiling is exactly 3,414 calls (910 + 2,504), and only two non-replacing infrastructure-diagnosis replay slots can raise the process ceiling to at most 3,416. Stage-1 failure terminates HUMAN_REQUIRED; v2 has no optional or result-triggered model panels.
system_thesis: The broader project asks whether experience can become useful later behavior. This proposal tests only one fixed prompted resolver on supplied local permutations in a minimal synthetic pre-context life: prospective commitments, a mechanical exactly-one raw-A READ plus exactly-one pre-A candidate-parent READ before a decisive REPLACE PREDICT with exact receipt/handle/capability provenance and matching terminal REPLACE for G04, frozen external text, and later action changes under selected-h corpus intervention. RETAIN remains a legal non-gate Dream-2 terminal. The proposal does not test lifetime learning, parameter change, LoRA, compression, autonomous discovery, learned control, a learned controller, persistence, or general/paper efficacy.

nodes.before: v1 had incompatible CPU maxima and unbounded staged roster paths.
nodes.after: A 64+64 full CPU gate has 10.5 CPU-minutes/root, a 1,540-minute mandatory joint ledger under the exact 1,560-minute/26-CPU-hour cap, zero model calls, 28 exact solver and 60 public-actor applications, and a sealed no-diagnostic decision tree.
nodes.rationale: Construct validity and every auxiliary suite must fit one exact joint envelope before model work.

nodes.before: v1 COMMIT could require payload bytes larger than its terminal output limit and overloaded REVISE.
nodes.after: Model-authored nodes stage before PREDICT; PREDICT selects their manifest; harness-only whole-object content commitments resolve a model-visible session capability at COMMIT; Dream-2 uses RETAIN/REPLACE/ABSTAIN while REVISE remains a workspace operation.
nodes.rationale: This makes terminal selection mechanically representable under hard caps without a content-identity side channel.

nodes.before: v1 opaque tests allowed semantic truth/false/solution classifiers.
nodes.after: Opaque primary audits only bytes, provenance, surface reads, target blindness, and behavior; AST alone receives semantic witnesses and remains non-rescuing.
nodes.rationale: Undefined opaque meaning cannot support semantic adjudication.

nodes.before: v1 merged memory retrieval, model reasoning, and physical action.
nodes.after: A separate target reader alone receives the assigned corpus/index, fixed literal memory handle, and typed query/cursor, and returns one bounded NOTE, AST record, or NOT_FOUND.
nodes.rationale: Memory access must terminate at a typed reader-to-Think boundary.

nodes.before: v1 did not isolate target-time model cognition from the actor.
nodes.after: Target Think receives public target state, public goal/legal menu, its own workspace, fixed memory handle, and charged reader result. It emits schema-valid USE(stem::suffix) for actor dispatch or terminates locally with LOCK; LOCK is never actor IPC.
nodes.rationale: The model chooses a public action without actor-private transition or score access.

nodes.before: v1 did not assign LOCK to a non-actor terminal owner.
nodes.after: A schema-valid LOCK terminates the Think loop locally and records a terminal status without a public-actor call.
nodes.rationale: LOCK cannot become an actor-visible action or hidden actor input.

nodes.before: v1 allowed the actor to consume memory-bearing state.
nodes.after: The public actor receives only current public state, public legal menu, exactly one emitted USE(stem::suffix), and sealed immutable transition bytes; it receives no LOCK, memory/corpus/index/query/result/digest/address/path/handle/capability/length/cache/timing/intervention/private-truth/score input.
nodes.rationale: Holding the emitted USE and public actor inputs fixed must make corpus and identity mutations irrelevant to actor input/output.

edges.before: Learned lanes had asymmetric preprocessing and catalog side channels.
edges.after: All learned lanes receive the same charged raw before/action/after plus public factor-blind slot-permutation payload; pre-READ catalog handles expose no content-derived metadata.
edges.rationale: Common supplied perception and typed reads prevent an extraction or metadata confound.

edges.before: Seed coupling and causal wording were underspecified.
edges.after: A cloned Dream-1 and COMMON_SEED Dream-2 invocations isolate raw A and its declared mechanical descendants. Each G04 branch performs exactly one charged raw-A READ and exactly one charged pre-A candidate-parent READ at distinct ordinals before its decisive PREDICT. The PREDICT provenance contains both exact receipt refs once, its public handles contain the raw-A handle once, and its parent capability is the capability minted by the pool-member candidate read. PREDICT and later COMMIT both say REPLACE; COMMIT selects exactly the newly PREDICTed capability and repeats ordered provenance byte-for-byte. RETAIN is a legal non-gate terminal. G04 also requires selected bytes distinct from every pre-A pool candidate and from the paired h branch, with ordered pool, clone, and seed-key equality.
edges.rationale: This is exactly a nonsemantic raw-A-conditioned branch-responsive selected-object update, not content rewriting or h-mediated action.

edges.before: The timing graph routed frozen corpus state directly toward a merged target actor.
edges.after: After the selected authentic corpus freezes at T2, the target-blind sham is materialized before any T3 target/query rendering; at T3 only the target-reader orchestrator supplies an assigned corpus/index reference and fixed handle to the reader.
edges.rationale: Corpus treatment is pre-target and actor-invisible.

edges.before: Reader output and actor input were not separated.
edges.after: One bounded NOTE, AST record, or NOT_FOUND passes over the sole typed reader-to-Think IPC edge.
edges.rationale: Think can use authorized memory while the actor cannot.

edges.before: Memory-bearing cognition and physical execution were merged.
edges.after: Only one validated literal USE(stem::suffix) crosses from Think to the public actor.
edges.rationale: The physical endpoint is USE-mediated, with no direct corpus-to-actor edge.

edges.before: LOCK could be confused with an actor action.
edges.after: A validated LOCK terminates Think locally, produces no actor IPC, and consumes no public-actor application.
edges.rationale: Actor inputs remain USE-only while Think retains an explicit stop operation.

edges.after: The actor returns only public next state and action-validity; B/evaluation never returns upstream.
edges.rationale: Later behavior is terminal and cannot repair memory or cognition.

loops.before: v1 loop had mutable terminal payload and candidate-REVISE ambiguity.
loops.after: Dream-1 stages an ordered one-or-two-object prospective pool. A fresh recurrent Dream-2 session performs exactly one charged raw-A READ before its decisive PREDICT; a non-ABSTAIN terminal also uses a charged Dream-1 candidate-parent read. For G04 there is exactly one of each read at distinct ordinals before decisive PREDICT; PREDICT provenance contains both receipt refs, its public handles contain the raw-A handle, and its parent capability is minted by that exact pool-member read. COMMIT is exactly RETAIN of a charged-read immutable Dream-1 candidate, REPLACE of a charged-read parent by the newly PREDICTed staged object, or capability-free ABSTAIN. G04 permits only REPLACE and requires COMMIT to select the PREDICT capability and repeat its ordered provenance byte-for-byte. One-shot Dream-2 is atomic and capability-free: RETAIN selects its immutable Dream-1 source slot, REPLACE carries sole response-local D2C01, and ABSTAIN selects neither. Workspace REVISE remains only node replacement. Resolver state ordinal r is zero-based while each emitted operation and RESOLVER_STEP records r+1.

claims.before: v1 wording could imply corpus-caused earlier predictions or semantic revision.
claims.after: On registered roots only, predictions are prospective. In each fresh COMMON_SEED Dream-2 h branch, exactly one charged raw-A READ and exactly one charged pre-A candidate-parent READ at distinct earlier ordinals preceded the decisive REPLACE PREDICT; PREDICT provenance contained both receipt refs, its public handles contained the raw-A handle, and its parent capability was minted by the exact pool-member read. Terminal REPLACE selected only the newly PREDICTed capability with byte-identical ordered provenance, exact B commitments were made, and the two branches selected byte-distinct objects that also differed from every pre-A pool candidate while ordered pool/clone/seed-key bytes matched. Separately, predeclared h=0 frozen-corpus interventions changed later executed USE actions under the exact gate.

acceptance_tests.setup: Certify every private state for all 64 factor and 64 independent roots, each capped at 10.5 CPU minutes; execute F07.01's exact auxiliary ledger 1344+16+15+25+40+30+55+15.
acceptance_tests.expected: All 128 roots and every auxiliary receipt exist; the mandatory total is exactly 1,540 CPU minutes, leaving exactly 20 minutes under the 1,560-minute (26 CPU-hour) hard cap and 26-hour wall stop, or Stage 0 is NOT_RUN with no root/suite replacement.

acceptance_tests.setup: Enumerate h/q,z/antipode, pre-A byte identity, target invariance, goal twins, factor target z xor h*1111, the 1/16 D4 theorem, F04.01-F04.06 HMAC/domain/endian/coupling vectors, and the model_visible_identifier golden/equality/collision vectors.
acceptance_tests.expected: Factor and conditional-uniform q certificates hold; COMMON_SEED excludes h_or_q, lane, condition, cut/intervention, arm, and scientific/diagnostic labels while retaining root/z/sampling topology/phase/target/twin/draw/ordinal; required h and SELF/control pairs share exact seed/sampler bytes, while ANALYSIS_PAIR_ONLY does not assert stepwise equality. Public event and raw-A handles are direct kind plus one-based source ordinals; every opaque model-visible receipt, capability, candidate handle, target handle, node/object capability, and reader receipt is deterministic from the treatment-free topology and zero-based issuance/source/resolver ordinals, is byte-identical in corresponding paired positions, and never encodes content, treatment, result, digest, length, path, cache, timing, score, or error.

Think consumes public target/goal/menu/workspace/handle/result, sends only schema-valid USE(stem::suffix) to actor, and handles LOCK locally without actor IPC or actor application. Recurrent Dream-2 performs its charged raw-A READ before decisive PREDICT, PREDICT provenance includes that raw-A handle, and COMMIT repeats its decision, selected capability, and provenance: RETAIN selects a charged-read immutable pool object with no new candidate; REPLACE selects the newly PREDICTed staged object with a charged-read parent; ABSTAIN is content/capability-free. Workspace REVISE only replaces a workspace node. Unknown/private fields, candidate-REVISE, post-response capabilities, malformed markers, over-cap bytes, digest/length exposure, and r-versus-r+1 errors fail.
